title: Scoped negative result: restored dirty borrowing cannot match CK/JP8 scratch prices
body:
Restoring borrowed dirty registers cannot replace the disposable coefficient-work register at the existing CK/JP8 boundary price. This scoped negative result proves minimum costs **4**, **6**, and **9..10** for a two-cycle, three-cycle and disjoint two-plus-three-cycle, even with **any finite number of restored dirty donors**. The disposable-scratch comparators cost 4, 5 and 8. **No new kappa.**

The new step is a write-count/read-only-specialization lemma: at the relevant short budgets at most one donor can be written, and donors that are only read can be specialized away for a lower bound. Complete GL(3,3), GL(4,3) and GL(6,3) radius-four searches then exclude the cheaper words. Python and separately represented C++ implementations compare every one of **2,373,527 states and minimum distances**; exact Fraction witnesses supply upper bounds.

For all **168** frozen historical boundary records, the resulting lower bill is **238 versus 224 primitives per real component**, at least 28 extra real primitives per orientation under separate component lowering. This is a local scalar-interface obstruction, not a physical row-saving result or a selected-supplier change. Nine versus ten for the combined cycle remains open.

Review `research/complex-restored-borrowed-boundaries/PROOF.md` for the reduction and its hypotheses; README, exact source pins, complete receipt, controls and validation are in the same package. Research and refreshed submission base: **1b59b624d21924f8e3537cdc1ac52d3be6eda2fe**. OS assignment seed 33. Selected PR1094 remains unchanged.

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/complex-restored-borrowed-boundaries/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/complex-restored-borrowed-boundaries/test_package.py
```

Expected marker: `PASS_COMPLEX_RESTORED_BORROWING boundaries=168 states=2373527 costs=4,6,>=9 arbitrary_restored_donors no_new_kappa`.

Validation: complete replay and all 11 test groups pass on CPython 3.14.6 and 3.9.6/macOS arm64; 37 gate omissions, dirty-donor destruction, seven source corruptions, receipt corruption, dense matrix/product oracles and offline relocation are covered. Byte-identical receipt regeneration and a full six-register UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer replay pass. Selected-record integrity and its five tests pass. Added focused Linux workflow is pending; no hosted CI pass is claimed. No full native/phase/hosting/precision/tape/all-size/outer-theorem replay is claimed.

Credit **ToikY's PR969** (`d1ee3f46a6167ea54913e070af3161c71a99e1f2`) for the actual deferred-swap construction; PR1145's narrative called it PR971 incorrectly. The retained source bytes are unchanged. This adapts Ross Richardson's PR1145 (`fd4d5ffc448361297e717aa30eafed578caf8e61`) checkers to the explicitly excluded borrowed-register contract and adds the universal reduction. **woklerx's PR1095** addresses the distinct monomial-prefix/disposable-workspace class. Credit also Sagar Thakrar PR696, faw01 PR839, Chafik Boukhalfa PR626, Jeremy Kothe PR622, icekylinx and the retained supplier lineage.

Prepared by **Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**, including the adapted independent implementation. No independent human review is claimed. Apache-2.0.
